Rule: KQL-01 Role assigned at subscription or management group scope
How to fire it safely: Assign Reader to an empty test group at a sandbox subscription, then remove it.

Rule: KQL-02 New secret or certificate added to an app registration or service principal
How to fire it safely: Add a short-lived secret to a test app registration in a non-production tenant or under a change ticket, then delete it.
The planned quarterly break-glass sign-in test, recorded in the change log. Do not sign in only to test this rule.

Rule: KQL-04 Key Vault secret read by an identity that is not on the expected list
How to fire it safely: Read a test secret in the sandbox vault with your own account (on a private path), which is not on the expected list.

Rule: KQL-05 Network security group rule created, changed or deleted
How to fire it safely: Add and remove a deny rule with a high priority number on a sandbox NSG.

Rule: KQL-06 Spike in WAF blocked requests from one client
How to fire it safely: From an allowed test client, send a handful of requests with a harmless SQL-injection pattern in a query string to a test path.
Put a ReadOnly lock on a sandbox VM's restore-point resource group, run an on-demand backup (it fails), then remove the lock.
Delete and recreate a test assignment in the sandbox management group.

Rule: KQL-09 Immutability policy on the log archive changed, locked or deleted
How to fire it safely: Extend the retention of the unlocked policy on a sandbox container by one day, then set it back.

Rule: KQL-10 Diagnostic setting deleted (logging switched off)
How to fire it safely: Create a throwaway diagnostic setting on a sandbox resource, then delete it.
